scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be pursuing or have completed postgraduate/doctoral studies in Science, Engineering/Technology, or Law from a university established under Indian law.
The applicant's graduation/post‑graduation/doctoral studies must be from a government‑recognized institute.
The internship must be a requirement specified under the applicant's course curriculum.
benefits_summary: A certificate of completion is issued; no honorarium is paid, but interns receive three days of leave per month.
documents_required: Cover letter containing a brief synopsis of the proposed topic
